description: Test class for verifying database migrations in an Android app using Room. Contains multiple test methods to ensure migrations from various versions are applied successfully, including combined migrations from version 3 to 5.

classes.name: DatabaseMigrationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing database migration sequences in Room database.

methods.name: testAllMigrations
methods.description: Tests applying all migrations from version 1 to 5.

methods.name: testMigration2To3
methods.description: Tests migration from version 2 to 3, adding 'screenAlwaysOn' column.

methods.name: testMigration3To4
methods.description: Tests migration from version 3 to 4, adding 'storageUri' column.

methods.name: testMigration4To5
methods.description: Tests migration from version 4 to 5, creating indices on 'cloud_ids'.

methods.name: testMigration3To5
methods.description: Tests direct migration from version 3 to 5 by applying sequential migrations.
